display.title: Episode 539: Rabbi Akiva's Negel Vasser and the Drunken Father (The Three Weeks)
display.summary_short: Join Hashem's army and beat the yetzer hara; Rabbi Akiva uses his only water in prison to wash his hands; Ahavas Yisrael; and a sad story about a boy whose father drinks.
display.summary_long: Broadcast during the Three Weeks, 5752; most of the program also aired in earlier years. Uncle Yossi invites children to join Tzivos Hashem, which sends members an ID card, emblem and wallet, and explains that Torah and mitzvos are the secret weapon that defeats the yetzer hara before Moshiach comes. A brother and sister lead the Shema. The first story tells how Rabbi Akiva, jailed for teaching Torah and given no water for three days, used his jug to wash his hands and make a brachah instead of drinking. The amazed ruler freed him and made him an advisor. Uncle Yossi then teaches Rabbi Akiva's 'great rule', to love your fellow as yourself, and the Alter Rebbe's teaching that Ahavas Yisrael leads to love of Hashem, which matters most in the Three Weeks, since the Churban came from a lack of it. The second story 'has no happy ending': Naftali, ashamed of his father's drinking, brings him to see a drunk lying in the street, but the father only asks where to get such a good drink. Uncle Yossi ties it to Parshas Acharei: the Torah shows us the ways of other nations only so we will not copy them. The show ends with Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery.
display.lesson: Cherish every mitzvah as Rabbi Akiva did, love every Jew, and learn from the bad ways of others only what not to copy.

date.note: 'Especially today, during the Three Weeks'; prayers for the Rebbe's recovery place it in 5752; one week after episode 538.
